avis.titre: Review for the Exfoliating Black Rice Ampoule & Exfoliating Rice Ampoule
avis.texte: This has been a pleasant addition to my skincare routine. I’ve only used it for a few days, but it feels gentle on my skin and leaves it feeling smooth and refreshed. It absorbs well, provides hydration, and hasn’t caused any irritation. I like that it’s lightweight and layers nicely with the rest of my skincare. I’m excited to continue using it and see how it helps with my skin over time.

I have very sensitive skin, especially on my face. I’ve never had acne problems, but have struggled with the black heads on my nose and any sort of cleaner sometimes worked, but always “upset” my pores. This rice exfoliant IS AMAZING!! The sebaceous filaments on my nose have started to disappear in just a couple of days! My skin is crazy soft and for the most part my pores are not irritated at all. Very quick and easy to use. You can see it work every time! It’s cleared up the little bit of discoloring on my head as well (shaved head). For the price I 100% recommend using these products!

This ampoule is a great choice if you want smooth skin without the harshness of a traditional scrub. It’s very hydrating and absorbs quickly, leaving a nice glow thanks to the niacinamide and rice bran. It's gentle enough for sensitive skin and daily use, though you’ll need to use it consistently for a few days to really notice a change in texture—great value for the size, but better for gradual brightening than an instant peel.
